counter_evidence.detail: The cited entry point only registers routes on `rest_api_init`; this line does not show any REST callback reaching `ElementorIntegration::get_form_ids()`.
`get_form_ids()` returns the merged results of two helper methods. It does not echo, print, or build HTML.
`get_elementor_form_ids_from_content()` extracts IDs with a fixed-prefix regex and returns reconstructed form ID strings, not markup.
`get_elementor_form_ids_from_actions()` returns the accumulated `$form_ids` array after parsing `$_POST['actions']`; the anchor is still a data return, not an output sink.
`find_form_widget()` also terminates by returning an array of collected element IDs, with no rendering step in the reviewed function.
The justified consumer expansion shows the returned values are assigned to `$current_form_ids` inside `maybe_unset_forms()` for repository comparison logic.
The identified downstream action is `$this->form_repository->delete( $form_id )`; this is bookkeeping side effect, not HTML/JS execution.
